title: 有馬記念の後に・感謝と誓いを共にして

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo fails to finish first. But despite her great disappointment, she heads to the concert stage together with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the last race of the year, which makes this is the last opportunity to show her gratitude to her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The winning concert they perform is the most exciting of the year.
